UNKNOWN: Never learns a clause, accepts a witness or refutation from UNKNOWN. Any incomplete solve makes cohort UNKNOWN; budget/output/process failure retains evidence and forbids silent rerun.
catalogue: Every lexicographic four-element subset of masks0..7; mask bit(2-i) is variable i literal satisfying value; T000..T069; no supplied answers.
cost_scope: One cold worker, six modules loaded once. Includes original oracle, all discovery/certification, replay build/solve/result checks, independent whole-case/shadow verification, streaming hashes/serialization/output and genuine native process exit. Common library cost is measured once; L+arm subtotals are not independent cold lifecycles. External meter memory excluded.
discovery: Every singleton [Xi=b], i=0,1,2 and b=0,1. Fresh original point model for each. Only complete finite exhaustion proposes the negation of the entire singleton; certify original-F truth and retain first2 distinct non-original clauses. Retain all proposals and UNKNOWNs.
ordinary_information: Same selected certified clauses supplied to ordinary_learned; ordinary_no originals only.
replay: Empty boundary then all6 discovery singleton boundaries, in each of4 arms; fresh state/model each solve; library frozen per original F.
same_point_inventory: Full original plus learned tuple/guard inventory in both arms; original R always active; only learned R assigned0 versus absent differs.
shadow: After search, recompose baseline and marked models at identical selected IDs+seed using each variant own candidate markings, compare complete t/m domains and reverse graph. No marked-state m-copy into baseline. Record repeated exclusion observations and exact first conflict witness, plus degree0/1 effects. Never used to guide search.
streaming: Exclusive canonical JSONL header, all70 verified cases, digest/count completion footer and EOF; release each case before next; summary has70 small rows.
